$schema: night-line color tokens — single source of truth for GDD §14 (Look and feel)
$source: Ported verbatim from the Night Line reference build (night-line.html, 00-tokens.js). Every SVG under sprites/ sets one of these hexes literally and repeats the name in data-token, so a re-theme is this file plus a rewrite pass.

bg.use: background canvas / sky base — the near-black the rest of the palette lights up against (display.backgroundColor, ui/crash-overlay.svg)

sky1.use: upper sky band, just off black so the horizon is not a hard cut

roadFillFar.use: road surface, far end — the ribbon darkens into the distance

shoulder.use: shoulder band either side of the lanes, so the road left is legible at a glance

laneMark.use: lane divider dashes on the road surface

edgeLine.use: self-lit road boundary line, unwarned state

edgeWarn.use: road boundary and cat's-eyes on the side you are running out of

barrier.use: roadside barrier and the unlit scenery post (road/reflector-post.svg) — dimmer than any anchor

barrierWarn.use: barrier on the side the car is drifting into

anchorDim.use: anchor post outside its throw window (anchor/post.svg) — cool, must never read as a hazard

anchorActive.use: anchor post while the throw window is open (anchor/post-open.svg) — brightest object in the frame after the cone

anchorHot.use: anchor lamp while the rope is on it (anchor/post-attached.svg)

rope.use: the rope itself and its attach burst (rope/attach-flash.svg)

ropeStrain.use: rope under tension and the snap burst (rope/snap.svg) — telegraphs the break before it happens

pickupBeam.use: high-beam pickup anchor variant (anchor/pickup-highbeam.svg) and the beam meter

carRoof.use: player car roof panel — the only thing that separates the car from a rectangle at distance

carWheel.use: front wheels, which counter-steer against the drift

rearLight.use: player car rear lights (car/rear-lights.svg) and a stalled vehicle's, pulsing independently of the body

headlight.use: the light itself: headlight cone, lamp bloom and warm wash (car/headlight-cone.svg). rgb(255,206,140) in the reference

hazard.use: reserved exclusively for obstacle silhouettes (obstacle/*.svg) and the low-power warning

hazardDark.use: the ground footprint an obstacle casts, drawn under it

ped.use: pedestrian hazards (obstacle/pedestrian*.svg) — warm, not the hazard red, because they move

hudBright.use: score and any text the player is meant to read at a glance

hudDim.use: HUD chrome — meter frames and labels, drawn at 0.30 opacity (ui/meter-frame.svg, ui/score-frame.svg)

hudWarn.use: low-power meter and its label — the same red as a hazard, on purpose
